R package · Output styling

Consistent outputs, Core Surveillance style.

A styling system for consistent visual outputs — ggplot2 themes, colour palettes, and dual number and date formatting for both Norwegian reports and international journals.

Get started Browse the reference →

Highlights

01

ggplot2 Themes

A Core Surveillance ggplot2 theme with configurable grid lines, legend position, and axis orientation.

02

Color Palettes

Named color palette families (primary, warning, posneg). scale_color_cs() and scale_fill_cs() apply them in ggplot2.

03

Dual Formatting

Parallel number and date functions for Norwegian domestic reports and international journal publications.

The csstyle color palettes
